video_title: LaMelo Ball Postgame Interview With Sean Dorcellus | 11.17.26

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on defensive intensity and team execution
quotes.excerpt: Honestly defense. I mean you seen the last play, I tried to make something happen, thought I got fouled.

text_blocks.speaker: Sean Dorcellus
text_blocks.text: LaMelo, what did it take to get this one done tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Honestly defense. I mean you seen the last play, I tried to make something happen, thought I got fouled. It wasn't that, so I said on defense we got to get it back. Got it back and then my teammates did the rest, made the bucket and then one more defensive stop.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball on the key to tonight win against a Western Conference opponent: It was all about defense. We had to get it back on the defensive end and my teammates did the rest to make the bucket and get the final stop.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball explains to a reporter how the team secured a win through defensive intensity and a final stop.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on maintaining focus for back-to-back wins
quotes.excerpt: Pretty much just dig deep, lock in, stay focused, listen to the coaches and follow the game plan.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: The mentality for this, back-to-back nights, back-to-back wins. What did it take to get both of these against the Western Conference foe?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Pretty much just dig deep, lock in, stay focused, listen to the coaches and follow the game plan pretty much.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball on the mentality for back to back wins: You have to dig deep, lock in, stay focused, listen to the coaches and follow the game plan.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball describes the team's mentality during back-to-back games and the importance of following the coaching staff's game plan.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the team's high level of offensive talent
quotes.excerpt: I feel like all the teams I've been on have been blessings.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Last night it was TJ with the 30 ball. Tonight it was I with the 30 ball. Have you ever played on a team that has this much offensive talent?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: I can't do my dogs in the past, but I feel like all the teams I've been on have been blessings.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball on the offensive talent of this Timberwolves roster: I cannot do my dogs in the past, but I feel like all the teams I have been on have been blessings.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball reflects on the offensive talent of his current team compared to his past experiences after a high-scoring performance.
